q: In goose v1.49.0, what is the core data shape replacing the legacy `Reply`/`ReplyPart`?
options: `Message { id, role, created, content: Vec<MessageContentBlock>, metadata }`
`Reply { parts: Vec<ReplyPart> }` where ReplyPart is Text or ToolCall
`Conversation { turns: Vec<ToolCall> }`
`Message { content: String, role: String }`
explanation: ReplyPart no longer exists in the tree — verify by grepping the checkout for ReplyPart.
ToolCall is one block kind, not the container of the whole conversation.
content is a Vec<MessageContentBlock>, not a single formatted string.

q: Why is `Message.content` a list of typed blocks instead of one text string?
options: One assistant turn can interleave text, tool requests, and thinking; blocks keep them typed, filterable per audience, and serde-round-trippable
Text cannot store YouTube links safely
Each provider parses a single string faster than structured data
Block lists were forced by an old rmcp limitation that is still on the issue tracker
explanation: Content safety has nothing to do with the block design.
Providers receive structured blocks and format them per envelope — the opposite claim.
rmcp is the source of Role and CallToolResult types, not the reason for block lists.

q: Which crate owns the `Message` struct in v1.49.0?
options: goose-provider-types, re-exported via goose-providers and goose
The goose crate itself, under src/agents/
The rmcp crate
goose-sdk-types
explanation: goose consumes it via `pub mod conversation { pub use goose_providers::conversation::*; }` in lib.rs.
rmcp contributes Role/CallToolResult but not Message.
goose-sdk-types carries ACP/GDK wire types, a different contract.

q: What does the custom serde deserializer wired on `Message.content` do?
options: Migrates legacy shapes: drops `conversationCompacted` blocks, migrates `reasoning` to `thinking`, sanitizes Unicode tags
Converts content to uppercase for storage
Rejects any message older than 30 days
HTTP-encodes the text for safe transfer
explanation: Storage is lossless; nothing gets uppercased in deserialization.
There is no age validation in the deserializer.
Transfer encoding is unrelated to serde's job here.

q: Which of these is a field of `ModelConfig` in goose-provider-types/src/model.rs?
options: model_name, context_limit, temperature, max_tokens, toolshim
model_name, api_key, provider_url, retries
prompt, response, tokens_in, tokens_out
workspace_root, git_branch, cwd
explanation: API keys never sit on ModelConfig; secrets live in the config/secrets layer.
ModelConfig shapes a provider call, it doesn't hold the conversation.
cwd/workspace belong to Session, not the model fingerprint.
